description_en: Call the CreateIoTCloudConnectorBackhaulRoute operation to create a backhaul route after binding a cloud connector instance to a VPC
description_zh: 调用CreateIoTCloudConnectorBackhaulRoute接口创建当前云连接器实例绑定VPC后的回程路由
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc create-iot-cloud-connector-backhaul-route --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateIoTCloudConnectorBackhaulRoute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud connector instance
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that ensures the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value on your client. The value must be unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. Each API request may have a different RequestId
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Performs a check. The backhaul route is not created. The system checks required parameters, request format, and service limits. If the check fails, the system returns the corresponding error code. If the check passes, the system returns the error code `DryRunOperation`.

false (default): Sends the request normally. After passing the check, the system returns an HTTP 2xx status code and creates the backhaul route
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建当前云连接器实例绑定VPC后的回程路由。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并创建云连接器实例绑定VPC后的回程路由
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cloud connector instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
